title: Runaway Shopping Cart in Rain and Glare
originalIntent: In heavy rain, low friction, and directional glare, a runaway shopping cart crosses ego's path, stops at the median, and rolls back. Ego approaches the conflict at no more than 20 km/h, stops at least 3 metres away without a lateral escape, remains stationary through rollback, and keeps at least 1.5 metres from the pedestrian.

criteria.description: Weather is heavy rain, friction scale is at most 0.58, visibility is directional glare, and ego is at most 20 km/h at the driveway conflict.
criteria.reason: The typed intent evaluator has no operational-condition or point-speed criterion; the unchanged scenario-specific gate evaluates these trace observations without changing thresholds.

criteria.description: The cart reverses lateral direction after stopping at the median.
criteria.reason: The typed intent evaluator has no path-direction-change criterion; the unchanged scenario-specific gate evaluates at least 0.3 metres of rollback and the authored rollback event on every trace.
